yolo26s_visdrone.name: YOLO26s (VisDrone)
yolo26s_visdrone.notes: Per-class thresholds tuned on VisDrone validation. Fast on CPU.

yolo26m_tile_visdrone.name: YOLO26m-Tile (VisDrone)
yolo26m_tile_visdrone.notes: Strongest single model (test-dev AP50 0.540). Counts carry 90% conformal ranges. Sliced: slow on CPU for a new photo.

ensemble_visdrone.name: Ensemble: YOLO26m-Tile + YOLOE-26m-FT
ensemble_visdrone.notes: Best AP (test-dev AP50 0.555), about twice the time. One threshold for all classes, not tuned for counting.

yolo26m_tile_uavdt.name: YOLO26m-Tile (UAVDT)
yolo26m_tile_uavdt.notes: Car, truck and bus only. Selected at epoch 1 by the project's rule. Hardly ever counts buses.

yolo26s_uavdt.name: YOLO26s (UAVDT)
yolo26s_uavdt.notes: Car, truck and bus only. Selected at epoch 1 by the project's rule.
